parts.label: (a)
parts.text: The random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(2.3)$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the probability that the sum of two independent values of $X$ is greater than 2.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: The random variable $S$ is the sum of 50 independent values of $X$. Use a suitable approximating distribution to find $\text{P}(S \leqslant 110)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: The random variable $Y$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(\lambda)$. Given that $\text{P}(Y = 3) = \text{P}(Y = 5)$, find $\lambda$.
